notes: Flat second reading: Fox (2016) uses the table for a simple regression of vocabulary on education; year is the GSS survey year, each wave holding many respondents, so it is filed as the grouping factor, and sex and the random intercept are the reader's proposal. RULE GAP: vocabulary is the number correct on a 10-word test with no trials column, filed continuous as Fox models it; survey year of a repeated cross-section read as a wave. An independent judge (2026-10-24) agreed: the education-only regression fits no wave term, so the fixed-wave rule does not apply.
